q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month, with a 20% discount for annual billing.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. For 5 people, it would be $40 per month. (Note: Annual billing saves 20%.)

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan allows you to keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: You can get a full refund for your Plus subscription within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately, you cannot get a refund as it has been more than 14 days. Please refer to the FAQ for more information on our refund policy.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app; Linux users can use the web app.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later. You can find this information in the FAQ under "Which platforms are supported?"

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web version of Example Notes requires an internet connection to function.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can restore your deleted note by going to Trash, selecting the note, and clicking "Restore". Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: SMS is not supported for two-factor authentication. Please use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus until the end of the current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. For more immediate concerns, you can email us at support@example.com.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team plans.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: The Plus plan allows you to use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. Would you like to open a support ticket?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Sorry, I don't know the answer. Would you like me to open a support ticket?

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: Sorry, I don't have an answer for that. Would you like to open a support ticket?

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. Linux users can use the web app instead.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I don't know how to write a Python script, but I can tell you that Example Notes is not related to coding. Please use our support form for coding questions.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I don't know. I can't provide weather information. If you have questions about Example Notes, I'm here to help.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days.

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan provides shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.
